definitions.explanation: The act of cutting grass or weeds, typically with a mower or sickle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{草刈|くさか}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I mowed the grass on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{草刈|くさか}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Grass grows fast in summer, so mowing is needed every week.

notes:
The act of cutting grass or weeds. A compound of ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass/weeds) and {刈|か}り (cutting). In rural Japan, {草刈|くさか}り is a common community activity, especially along roads and rice paddies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草刈|くさか}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mow grass
- {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}: lawn mower; weed trimmer
- {草刈|くさか}り{鎌|がま}: sickle for mowing
- {草刈|くさか}り⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: mowing work

- ⟦{芝刈|しばか}り→芝刈り：08532_shibakari⟧: lawn mowing (specifically for lawn grass)
- ⟦{除草|じょそう}→除草：18648_josou⟧: weeding; weed removal
